items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I got the same guys that started with me, Frank Clark on bass, Bob Carroll, Willard Brown, Godley and Call Cobbs.

ctx.x: Who was working with you now, it wasn't Buster Smith?
I got Willard Brown back. I got the same guys that started with me, Frank Clark on bass, Bob Carroll, Willard Brown, Godley and Call Cobbs.
Call Cobbs you picked up here in New York?
